name: Joel
bio: He may not be the fastest but he'll make sure you eat his dust on the climb. The strongest legs in the west.

name: Layla
bio: A scrappy, strong downhill racer. Rock gardens don't scare her, but curbs do.

name: Big Tyler
bio: Like a sasquatch on a bike, it's intimidating to see him coming.

name: Aaron
bio: Being on his bike makes him happy. Almost more than being with his family.... almost.

name: Annelise
bio: Don't let her RBF fool you. She's the best supporter, cheer mom out there.

name: Shelby
bio: Her car is packed like Mary Poppins' bag. If you need something, she probably has it.

name: Sophia
bio: She doesn't show up to any of the races but she's cheering you on wherever she is... probably at band camp.

name: Carter
bio: He would rather be anywhere else. At least he's still making memories, even if they're not happy ones.

name: Cameron
bio: He's not racing yet, but he's already mastered the most important part: eating the post-ride snacks.

name: Allen
bio: The most senior rat in the pack. He's traded race runs for cheering from the sidelines, but you'll still find him at every race he can make it to.

name: April
bio: The seniorita of the operation. She doesn't race, but cheers with the best of them.

name: Little Tyler
bio: Claims full team loyalty, schedule permitting. The schedule has never permitted.

name: Ivy
bio: Still learning which way the pedals go, but she's fierce about it. In charge of the German division — questionable qualifications, unquestionable confidence.

name: Kim
bio: Loves this team fiercely. Loves watching from home even more. Full support, zero dust in her shoes.

name: Briana
bio: Would like to make it to a race but somehow always ends up finding out how it went from the group chat instead.
